COMPLICATIONS OF HEADACHE
Depend on the cause and type
- Most headache attacks are benign with no sequelae apart from reduced
economic productivity/wastage of medications
- The dreaded complication is coning from raised intracranial pressure
- Blindness may follow temporal arteritis and unrelieved raised pressure in
idiopathic intracranial hypertension (pseudotumour cerebri)
- The risk of epilepsy is higher in those who suffer from migraine headache
